signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.63 deduplicated MRC crossing diagnostics release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/pullback_amount/trade_mode/tp_control overrides. TP control normal preserves current TP behavior; trailing-stop suppresses normal TP, trails the virtual SL, and places a two-tick recovery TP after an SL cross.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Pullback amount %
params.description: Forced pullback entry size as a percent of the normal deployable budget.

params.name: Trade mode
params.description: Choose single-order execution or martingale ladder execution.

params.name: TP control
params.description: Normal keeps the current TP behavior. Trailing stop uses only a favorable-only virtual SL and places a recovery TP two ticks beyond price after the SL is crossed.
